subject: general
question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which best substitute of the words/sentence.**

A military or political group that rules a country after taking power by force.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Junta**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

 
• Let us look at the **meaning** of the correct answer:-

 
 
• **Junta***(noun) *- a group, especially of military officers, who rule a country by force.
 
• For Example - Armed with the newest weapons, the** junta **faced little to no resistance as it drove out the government.
 
 
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the other options:-

 
 

 **WORD**
 **MEANING**
 
 

 Suffrage*(noun)*
 the right to vote in political elections.
 
 

 Emancipation*(noun)*
 to free from restraint, control, or the power of another especially; to free from bondage.
 
 

 Egalitarianism*(noun)*
 the doctrine that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct one word for the given descriptive sentence is ***Junta*.
